note: Hamilton County Conservation park on 249-acre Little Wall Lake (owned by the Iowa DNR), ~2 mi S of Jewell. Water is shut off about November 1 to April 1. Boat ramp, fishing jetty, swim beach and kayak/canoe rentals from the host; three rental cabins; the Jewellsworth Trail runs to Ellsworth. --Claude

Open sight lines to the lake from the south rows, so lakeview holds (imagery estimates).
